DIAGNOSIS READY: Mallet Finger

Based on your history of trauma and the X-ray showing soft tissue swelling without a fracture, the inability to flex your distal interphalangeal joint combined with the finger extending in a resting position is highly characteristic of an avulsion injury to the extensor tendon. This condition is known as a Mallet Finger.

I have identified the diagnosis based on the clinical evidence provided; no further tests or questions are required at this time.

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Rupture of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon at its point of insertion
